rows.en: ...Is that the energy core's flame he's holding!?
...Is that the energy core's flame he's holding!?
...And what he's holding looks like the energy core's flame.
...So that thing he's holdin' is the energy core's flame!?
...Is that the energy core's flame he's holding!?
...Is that the energy core's flame he's holding!?
What are you standing around for!! Let's rescue him while we've got the chance!
Taro is in our hands. I will tolerate no interference.
What are you planning to do with him!?
That is no business of yours!!
Then I'll do it by force if I have to!!
Then I have no choice but this...!!
If it's come to this, then...!!
If it's come to this, we've got no choice!!
You bastard!! Quit gettin' in my way!!
Move!! I'm going to save Taro!!
You fools!! Letting your hearts waver with the final ring right before your eyes!!
The final match is about to begin!!
Never in my wildest dreams did I imagine you heroes would fight your way up this far.
But now that it has come to this, you shall show me the finest fight of all!!
Now that it has come to this, I would very much like to see the finest fight of all!
...Now then, allow me to introduce your opponent.
I took you for ones with steadier nerve, yet you let a mere ice statue like that distract you...
I shall cut you down and prove my strength the greatest in the universe!!
Very well! Are both sides ready?

notes.note: Tail of the 14-slot leader block begun in story_085 (#0.3-0.58, 4 rows per slot). Slot order from the 0462.bla Pt_Chara_Check chain (ids 11,12,14,15,6,7,8,9,10,5,4,3,2,1): Ultraman, Seven, Mebius, Zero, Nu, Zeta, God Gundam, Wing Zero, 00, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1. So #0.35-38 = 00, #0.39-42 = OOO, #0.43-46 = W, #0.47-50 = Den-O, #0.51-54 = RX, #0.55-58 = Rider 1. 'Energy core' kept lowercase to match story_069 #0.176.
OOO slot: polite '-san' on Taro dropped per style; politeness carried by the hesitant 'Is that...'. Same line elsewhere (no -san) rendered 'Ultraman Taro...!?'.
Labelled Rider 1 by the trace, but by slot position this is the W variant (Philip/Shotaro rows follow); 'nanda' voiced as Shotaro. The Rider 1 name label appears to be the leader placeholder.
Ankh to the party; 'tasukeru' object = Taro (frozen, held by Master Gundam), subject 'we' restored.

#0.65-78: 14 leader variants, identical text. Chain order here: God Gundam, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero, Mebius, Zero, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Den-O, RX, Rider 1. Same order used for the attack/hurt pairs #0.82-109 (script shows TextIdOffset+81+26 for the last pair).

Pairs by slot: #0.82 God Gundam, #0.84 Nu, #0.86 Zeta, #0.88 00, #0.90 Wing Zero, #0.92 Mebius, #0.94 Zero, #0.96 Seven, #0.98 Ultraman, #0.100 OOO, #0.102 W, #0.104 Momotaros ('yarou', 'janee'), #0.106 RX, #0.108 Rider 1. Identical Japanese kept identical ('Out of the way!!', '...Uwah!!', '...Guah!!'). Mebius's curt 'soko wo doke' left as written.
Not played on the traced path (script jumps #0.110 -> #0.112); unlabelled alternate line, presumably Master Gundam in another branch. Same for #0.114 (alternate of #0.113).
Zamsha's archaic register; 'ice statue' = the frozen Taro the heroes were distracted by.
Yes/No prompt (YesNoWinIn) under Master Gundam's name; addresses both the Hero Team and Zamsha.

report: All 80 rows translated. Leader-variant slots assigned from the 0462.bla Pt_Chara_Check chains (14 slots incl. God Gundam). #0.43 labelled Rider 1 voiced as W (slot position). #0.111/#0.114 are unplayed alternates on the traced path. No new names; 'energy core' follows story_069.
